title: Keegan Allen of “Pretty Little Liars” Robbed at Gunpoint: Shocking Vulture Exclusive Revealed
body:
The actor best known for playing Ezra Fitz on the hit series *Pretty Little Liars* revealed on Instagram that he was robbed at gunpoint on a Los Angeles street late Tuesday night, posting a chilling video that showed fresh blood streaming down his face and neck. In a terse caption—“My life for a watch”—Keegan Allen disclosed that the assault occurred while he was walking home from a late‑night rehearsal, and that the assailant fled the scene after demanding his watch. Police have opened an investigation, and the incident has sparked an outpouring of support from fans and colleagues across the entertainment industry.

Allen, 34, posted the footage at approximately 2:15 a.m., the grainy clip capturing a brief, shadowed encounter before a flash of light reveals the shooter’s gun. The video ends abruptly as the attacker disappears around a corner, leaving the actor clutching his neck where a deep cut had been inflicted. In a follow‑up story on Instagram, Allen confirmed that he received medical attention at a nearby urgent‑care clinic, where doctors stitched the wound and administered a tetanus shot. He described feeling “shaken but grateful” to have escaped with his life, adding that the watch—an expensive timepiece he had recently purchased—was the only item taken.

Law enforcement officials say the incident fits a pattern of increasingly bold robberies targeting high‑profile individuals in affluent neighborhoods of Los Angeles. Detective Laura Martinez of the LAPD’s Robbery Division noted that “the use of a firearm in a street‑level robbery, especially against a public figure, is a serious escalation.” She confirmed that detectives are reviewing surveillance footage from nearby businesses and have canvassed the area for witnesses. While no arrests have been made, the department is urging anyone with information to come forward, emphasizing that the suspect may still be at large.

The attack has ignited a broader conversation about safety for actors and other public figures who often navigate the city without bodyguards after work hours. Industry insiders point out that many performers, especially those who have transitioned from teen‑drama fame to adult careers, tend to keep a low profile, making them vulnerable to opportunistic crimes. Talent agencies have begun advising clients to adopt stricter personal security measures, such as traveling in groups, using ride‑share services after dark, and maintaining heightened awareness of their surroundings.

Fans responded swiftly to Allen’s post, flooding social media with messages of solidarity and concern. The hashtag #StaySafeKeegan trended on Twitter within hours, and co‑star Troian Bellisario posted a heartfelt note, praising the actor’s courage and urging anyone who knows the perpetrator to assist the investigation. A fundraising campaign launched on GoFundMe has already raised over $25,000 to cover medical expenses and potential counseling services, reflecting the strong community support that often rallies around victims of violent crime.

As the LAPD continues its search for the gunman, Allen has indicated that he plans to return to work on his upcoming projects, including a guest appearance on a streaming drama slated for release next spring. He also hinted at using his platform to advocate for stronger gun‑control measures and increased street‑level policing in high‑risk areas. While the physical wounds may heal quickly, the psychological impact of such a traumatic event can linger, and Allen’s willingness to speak openly about the ordeal may help destigmatize discussions about violence in the entertainment community.

The incident serves as a stark reminder that fame does not shield individuals from the dangers that affect ordinary citizens, and it underscores the need for both personal vigilance and systemic solutions to curb street crime. As investigations proceed, the hope is that justice will be swift, the perpetrator will be apprehended, and Keegan Allen will be able to move forward, both personally and professionally, with the support of his fans and the broader industry behind him.
